scope: Bounded pilot of the replay/comparison additions on pinned consumer data. The direct baseline shares the existing compiler and constraint semantics; this is not an independent test that the Metamap kernel beats every simpler graph.
baseline: Direct compileMetamap, compileProjection, stable-ID diff, and runtime-entry comparison, supplied the same graph, policy, packs, context, time, and projection specification.
metrics: false runtime-change flags on binding-only controls
expansionGate: An advantage in held-out correctness or runtime-change localization at no additional false rejections must be demonstrated before broader scope. A tie does not satisfy this gate. Timing is reported as overhead, not a replacement for correctness.

cases.requirement: Every route has exactly one endpoint
Different authorization targets remain inspectable while preserving policy-reference coverage
Stable identities survive a locator move; projected locator changes remain visible
Every selected semantic route has one implementation
Observed providers supply a context and consumers resolve required contexts
Authorization target changes are observable without implicit approval
Administrative metadata does not manufacture runtime entry changes

projectionPreparation: Match the pinned consumer generator: topology projection selection adds the sorted routing:route IDs from the pinned web route graph before either path evaluates it. The template alone is not the actual consumer selection.
